package sample

type profiler struct {
	last  int
	marks int
}

func (p *profiler) Mark(now int) {
	if now < p.last {
		return
	}
	p.last = now
	p.marks = p.marks + 1
}

func Bounded(s string, max int) string {
	if max <= 0 {
		return ""
	}
	keep := max - 3
	// mutate-exempt: the mark is three bytes, and what that costs is the business of the test
	// that measures it rather than of this one - a reason written over two lines on purpose,
	// so that what it covers is the line under the whole comment.
	if keep <= 0 {
		return s[:max]
	}
	return s[:keep]
}

func Clamp(n int) int {
	// mutate-exempt: one line of reason, directly over what it covers.
	if n > 100 {
		return 100
	}
	return n
}

func Untouched(a, b int) int {
	return a + b
}
